0022600002.text: The New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers in the first game of the 2026-27 season for both teams, neither of which has played yet. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (hip), while Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives New York a 55% chance to win.
